name: Flashcards
author: Oleh Kupriianov
description: Anki-style spaced-repetition word trainer in the Omarchy bar, with pronunciation audio and translations. Norwegian by default, any language you add.

barWidget.description: Shows the next due word in the bar. Click to see the answer, hear the pronunciation, and pass or fail the card.

schema.label: Deck
schema.description: Name of the deck to study. New cards are added to this deck.

schema.label: Speech language code
schema.description: Language code for pronunciation audio, for example no, sv, de, fr, uk.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Show the current word, the number of due cards, or only the icon.

schema.label: Cards kept ready
schema.description: How many upcoming cards the panel holds in memory, so the next card appears instantly.

schema.label: Play pronunciation automatically
schema.description: Play the audio when a card appears in the open panel.

schema.label: Open the panel every N minutes (0 = never)
schema.description: When cards are due, open the panel on this interval so you can answer without clicking the bar.
